verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (for example, restricted Runloop API keys or permission scopes) for an agent. Agent Gateways and MCP Hub keep real credentials hidden from agents, and account secrets inject keys as environment variables. These are adjacent credential-protection features, not scoped credential issuance, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
